site.name: Alloy Studios
site.tagline: A small team making fast browser games.

roadmap.title: The whole catalogue is reworked
roadmap.detail: Every game has now been rebuilt or replaced - the last of them being Echoes, Abyssal Dredging, Sole & Co. and Orbit Dash. Each one got its own committed art direction rather than a shared house style, and the full detail for all of them is in the update log.

roadmap.title: Real thumbnails for every game
roadmap.detail: Every card in the library now shows a frame rendered from the game itself, instead of a generated colour tile.

roadmap.title: New games
roadmap.detail: With the back catalogue caught up, the focus goes back to making new things. Hardburn and Rats With Wings were the first two out; more are in the works.

site.intro: Alloy Studios makes small, fast browser games - roguelites, sandboxes, tower defense, idle games and whatever else is worth trying next. Everything runs instantly in a tab, with nothing to download and nothing to install.
about: Every game here is built as a single self-contained page. That is a deliberate constraint: no engine to load, no asset packs to download, no launcher. You click a link and you are playing inside a second or two, on a phone or a laptop, and it still works years later because there is nothing to rot.
It is a small operation. One developer builds the games, one steers what gets made next and keeps the ideas coming, and one plays everything to destruction before it goes live.
The catalogue moves fast and openly. Games ship in beta, get rebuilt, and sometimes get pulled. Each one's source lives on GitHub, so what you play is exactly what is in the repo.

games.title: Neon Survivor Legends
games.tagline: Survive the swarm, fuse legendary powers.
games.description: Level seven base weapons to max and fuse them in pairs. Hold exactly three Fusions at once to unlock a Super Fusion. Endless roguelite survival against a swarm that never stops growing.
games.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space to dash, 1-3 to pick

games.title: Meridian
games.tagline: High noon in the machine hall.
games.description: A first-person weapon-skin range, relit from a night-shift machine hall to a daylit one - clerestory glazing, white steel, hard sun across the floor. Fifty-nine skins across two new top tiers: Forged finishes that react to the game, and Zenith finishes that perform, one per weapon.
games.controls: Mouse to aim and fire, F to inspect, crates and trade-up in the menus

games.title: Port Vesper
games.tagline: Eighteen square blocks of bad decisions.
games.description: An open-city sandbox: drive, shoot, jack cars, rob shops and outrun the police. The law only knows what it sees, so break line of sight and they search your last known position instead of you.
games.controls: WASD to move or drive, mouse to aim, E to enter a car, R to rob, Space to handbrake

games.title: Grand Line
games.tagline: Sea of Fruits.
games.description: A top-down pirate action-RPG drawn like a woodblock adventure print. Sail an open sea, make landfall on five islands, and fight your way up the Grand Line with a cutlass and a Devil Fruit. Four fruits with three abilities each - bosses drop theirs, and wild ones wash up on the islands.
games.controls: WASD move, mouse aim, click cutlass, Q E R Devil Fruit, Space dash, F talk, M chart

games.title: Rank Zero: Sovereign Protocol
games.tagline: Write your grade up from E to S.
games.description: An action RPG fought on the page of an open book. Every hit you land writes your grade up from E to S and every hit you take strikes it out - and the grade drives your damage, cooldowns and gold. Sixteen weapons with sixteen mechanics, twelve ultimates, and nine Sovereigns waiting at the top.
games.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, dash through a telegraph to parry

games.title: Echoes
games.tagline: Recovered audio. Do not play alone.
games.description: Found-tape horror in three tracks, built on two senses that disagree: the lamp shows the truth, the echo shows memory. The echo is a real expanding wavefront, so returns arrive near-to-far and phosphor only remembers where a wall was, not what has moved since. Headphones strongly recommended - sound is information here.
games.controls: WASD move, mouse aim, F lamp, Space echo pulse, RMB focus beam, C hold breath

games.title: Aura Fighters
games.tagline: Charge your ki. Transform. Clear the wave.
games.description: Wave-based arena brawling with a power level that never stops climbing. Eleven transformations that each play differently - their own melee signature, ki blast and special - against four rival archetypes that telegraph every attack. Charge ki, read the tell, transform, and take a Zenkai boost every time a wave falls.
games.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, Q to dash, 1 ki blast, 2 special, hold C to charge, T to transform

games.title: Foil & Fortune
games.tagline: Run the card shop floor.
games.description: Card shop management. Order cartons from the wholesale catalog, shelve and price them, scan customers through the till, and keep reputation and cleanliness up as the queue grows. Better sets stay locked behind licences.
games.controls: WASD to move around the shop, click to interact

games.title: Abyssal Dredging
games.tagline: Idle salvage from the trench.
games.description: Idle deep-sea salvage on a wet steel deck at night. Drop nets into a real water column and watch the catch ride up through storm sea, marine snow and drifting leviathans before the log ever tells you what you got. Nine rarity tiers, thirty-four items, and collapsible docks so you can fold the interface away and just watch the ocean.
games.controls: Mouse / touch

games.title: Neon Speed Simulator
games.tagline: Gather speed, unlock skins and trails.
games.description: Build up raw speed, spend it on upgrades, and unlock skins with trails in the hangar. Sign in to keep your progress across sessions, or jump straight in as a guest.
games.controls: Mouse / touch

games.title: Cosmic Climb
games.tagline: 3,000 metres to the centre of the universe.
games.description: Climb from the sky through the stratosphere, deep space and nebulas to reach the Center of the Universe, three thousand meters up, one jump at a time.
games.controls: A/D or arrows to move, W, Up or Space to jump

games.title: Orbit Dash
games.tagline: One button. An antique orrery.
games.description: You are a brass bead running the tracks of an 18th-century orrery, drawn as a cyanotype blueprint. Tap to change track, thread the verdigris gates to build a chain, and wind the mainspring - then hold to spend it, slowing the whole machine so you can shatter the debris instead of dodging it.
games.controls: Tap or Space to change track, hold to spend the mainspring

games.title: Multiverse Fighters
games.tagline: Twelve fighters. Twelve realms. One ring.
games.description: A 2D fighter with twelve characters pulled from twelve different realms - shinobi, soul reapers, machines, Olympians, cartoons - each with their own normals, specials and an ultimate with its own charge stance and camera. Five opponent levels that run your exact code, so the AI can never do anything you cannot.
games.controls: A/D move, Space jump, W/S aim, Shift dash, J and K attack, L special, U ultimate

games.title: Flytale
games.tagline: A short story, told by a fly.
games.description: A six-chapter story told from a fly's point of view, drawn in hard 1-bit pixel art on a fixed 28-colour palette. The sink, the ant picket line, an ambush you can only survive, the moth at the hall lamp, the spider's toll booth, then the kitchen - where the man works through eight weapons before his bare hands.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD to fly, Z to confirm, X to cancel, M to mute

games.title: Madballs
games.tagline: Physics, destruction, loot.
games.description: Drag the slingshot, let go, and wreck the level. Fourteen stages, crates to crack open, and thirty-seven skins to hunt down - each with its own ability you trigger mid-flight for a second shot at the wreckage.
games.controls: Drag from the slingshot to fire, Space or click mid-flight for your skin's ability

games.title: Elementalis
games.tagline: Wizard of the Broken Wilds.
games.description: The old magic shattered into elements and scattered across the wilds. Find the shrines, slay their wardens, and take the power back. Master elements in the Grimoire and fuse them into new ones as you go.
games.controls: WASD move, mouse aim, click to cast, 1-4 spell slots, Shift to blink, E to commune, C for the Grimoire

games.title: Sole & Co.
games.tagline: Grandma left you the shop. Don't blow it.
games.description: You inherited a two-metre-wide sneaker shop, five pairs and $2,400. Stock the shelves, read the day s heat, work the market and the customs bench, and make rent before the doors close. Twelve models across six sole architectures and seventeen colourways, so the stock on your wall actually looks like stock.
games.controls: Mouse to stock, price and serve

games.title: Redwater
games.tagline: A frontier tale. Pick a side.
games.description: A top-down open-world western RPG. You ride into Redwater with a rusted six and no side; by the end the whole county knows which one you picked. Six thousand acres of bleached flats and red mesa drawn like a spaghetti western printed on an 1880s wanted poster, twelve named places, twenty guns and four that wake up.
games.controls: WASD move, mouse aim, LMB fire, RMB Dead Eye, Space roll, E use, R reload, Q ability, F awakening, Tab journal, M map

games.title: Hardburn
games.tagline: You launch a missile. Then you have to fly it.
games.description: A physics time-attack. Hold the motor and it burns; let go and you're a dart with gravity attached. The mouse aims, WASD swings the airframe off that line so you can burn sideways out of a corner, and a nose-fired grapple carves the turns you can't. Seeded courses, so any word you type builds the same track forever.
games.controls: Space to launch and hold for thrust, mouse to aim, WASD to swing the airframe, X to realign, E grapple, Shift hard burn

games.title: Rats With Wings
games.tagline: A small grey menace in a sunny plaza.
games.description: A 3D pigeon simulator. You have 120 seconds and a limited payload. Bomb pedestrians from above, desecrate the bronze General for a fortune, snatch ice cream mid-lick, and set off car alarms because you can. Eating refills ammunition, fast hits chain a chaos multiplier, and cooing summons the flock. Your splats stay on the pavement all round.
games.controls: Mouse to fly, click to bomb, eat to reload, coo to summon the flock
